background: Sam White is a Sublette County commissioner. The official commissioner profiles page lists him as a member, with a term expiring January 1, 2029. He won the November 2024 general election. Official July 14, 2025, commissioners proceedings record that he moved to appoint Jessica Rice as interim county clerk.
